mechanism.plausibility_rationale: TNF-alpha inhibitors are immunosuppressive agents used for autoimmune conditions. There is no established pharmacological mechanism linking these drugs to an increased risk of frostbite, which is a physical injury caused by freezing temperatures. While immunosuppression might theoretically increase susceptibility to secondary infections following tissue damage, it does not directly cause or predispose a patient to the environmental condition of frostbite.
